cases.script:
[[ $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
T=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/passwd-syscall-diagnostic-r16.py
C=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/passwd-trace-canary-target-r16.py
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$T" --log "$HOME/positive-trace.json" -- /usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" files
rc=$?
[[ $rc == 7 ]] || exit 11
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$T" --log "$HOME/fork-trace.json" -- /usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" fork
rc=$?
[[ $rc == 125 ]] || exit 12
/usr/bin/python3 -I - <<'CHECK'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/parity-home')
d=json.loads((p/'positive-trace.json').read_text())
assert d['exec_seen'] and d['exit_status']==7 and 'error' not in d
r=d['records']
assert all('return' in x for x in r)
assert any(x['syscall']=='read' and x['args'][0]==123456 and x['return']==-9 and x['is_error'] for x in r)
for names in [('open','openat'),('link','linkat'),('rename','renameat','renameat2'),('unlink','unlinkat'),('fsync',)]:
    assert any(x['syscall'] in names and x['return']>=0 and not x['is_error'] for x in r),names
assert d['after_filter']['NoNewPrivs']==1 and d['after_filter']['Seccomp']==2
n=json.loads((p/'fork-trace.json').read_text())
assert 'descendant process attempt' in n['error']
assert any(x['syscall'] in ('fork','vfork','clone','clone3') and x['return']==-1 and x['is_error'] for x in n['records'])
print('passwd tracer canaries: complete file observations, EBADF, exit propagation, denied fork verified')
CHECK
cases.stdout: passwd tracer canaries: complete file observations, EBADF, exit propagation, denied fork verified
cases.purpose: Validate diagnostic observer against known file syscall outcomes and forbidden descendant creation in a disposable root guest. No product credit.
cases.oracle: Independent Python os calls; exact EBADF and fork EPERM, propagated exit7, successful file operations and complete observer entry/exit records.
cases.comparison: Complete structured trace plus exact terminal marker; missing or malformed observations fail.
